entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I heard they finally turned you loose.[n]I'm glad you're doing okay.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I expected at least a phone call,[n]though...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Anyhow! You're free, and that's worth[n]celebrating.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I was hoping I'd get a chance to hand[n]this over, so this is good timing.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You know how it was Valentine's Day[n]yesterday?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: It's just a token of my appreciation,[n]so don't go feeling guilty about not[n]getting me anything.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: How about you consider it a sign of[n]trust? From one comrade to another.
